articles.summary: Veteran Technology Executive with 30+ Years Leading Enterprise Engineering, AI and Digital Commerce Platforms to Lead GrabAGun’s Technology Strategy GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW), an online retailer of firearms, ammunition and related accessories, today announced the appointment of John Swanagon as Chief Technology Officer effective September 1, 2026. Mr. Swanagon will report to Chief Executive Officer Marc Nemati and will lead the Company’s technology strategy, software engineering and artificial intelligence initiatives across both GrabAGun.com and PEW Logistics LLC. Mr. Swanagon brings more than 30 years of technology leadership experience across healthcare, financial services, payments, telecommunications, media and connected commerce, including large-scale platform modernization, AI deployment and product commercialization.
